claims_checked.claim: Five DORA metrics, grouped throughput (change lead time, deployment frequency, failed deployment recovery time) and instability (change fail rate, deployment rework rate); definitions as paraphrased; guide last updated January 2026
MTTR/time to restore service renamed and narrowed to failed deployment recovery time in 2023; deployment rework rate added and metrics regrouped in 2024
DORA metrics consistent with the site's DevOps page (five metrics, same groups, Jan 2026 guide, 2023/2024 history) and Agile metrics/continuous delivery pages

Trunk-based development: three or fewer active branches, branches lasting no more than a few hours, merge to trunk at least daily, no code freezes or integration phases; broken build fixed first or reverted
Automated test feedback in under ten minutes locally and in CI; do not tolerate flaky tests; failures should indicate a real defect
Fowler CI article updated Jan 2024; merge at least daily with automated build including tests; developed by Kent Beck as part of XP in the 1990s; CI server on feature branches is not CI
Cohn's test automation pyramid in Succeeding with Agile (2009); end-to-end UI tests brittle, expensive to write, slow; ice-cream cone
Ham Vocke's two rules: tests at different granularity; fewer tests the higher the level
Release toggles 'should generally not stick around much longer than a week or two' (Pete Hodgson)
DORA 2025 State of AI-assisted Software Development: nearly 5,000 technology professionals; AI amplifies strengths and dysfunctions
Agile Manifesto principles quoted (deliver working software frequently; working software primary measure of progress; continuous attention to technical excellence)
2020 Scrum Guide: multiple Increments within a Sprint; Sprint Review never a gate to releasing value; DoD definition; 'various processes, techniques and methods can be employed'
Extreme Programming Explained 1st ed. 1999, 2nd ed. with Cynthia Andres 2004
US-01 password reset story and acceptance criterion exist in the site's user story template
